name: Amir Balazade
headline: Front-End Engineer
summary: Front-End Engineer, **7+ years** across FinTech, Web3, B2B SaaS and e-commerce, on screens dense with tables and charts where a wrong number is noticed in seconds. A working app is not the finish line: implementation and core must hold. Comfortable turning a complicated business into features with product design and stakeholders, and drawn to R&D and AI work.

roles.title: Front-End Engineer
bullets: Built a mobile-first, non-custodial wallet PWA across **7 blockchains**, with per-chain signing, KYC and on-ramp integrations.
Shipped **3 Angular and TypeScript apps**: the wallet, an admin panel, and a payment page with an **80 kB** initial download.
Integrated REST APIs into secure workflows for digital assets, and presented the product at the company's Web Summit booth.

roles.title: Front-End Engineer
bullets: Delivered an order management system with a cross-functional Agile team, pair programming daily with the desk.
Streamed real-time data over SignalR into AgGrid, Highcharts and TradingView views for **5,000+ active traders**.
Moved the charting libraries off the initial bundle, taking it from **5.1 MB to 1.9 MB** and first load from **6.4 s to 2.8 s**.
Onboarded new joiners onto the stack and the brokerage domain, and ran knowledge-sharing sessions.

roles.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Developed a B2B SaaS CRM in React and Node.js, with in-browser WebRTC calls for **up to 6** and **no native client**.
Led the R&D that chose the core stack, reworked the state store, and built secure cloud storage and real-time chat.

roles.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Raised code quality across inherited React projects, and developed virtual tours for architectural projects.
Contributed React work to an automation system that **cut 30% of the paperwork** between contractors and project managers.

projects.name: zhambon.com
bullets: Designed and built an investment pool Angular PWA on NestJS and PostgreSQL, with **4 role-based domains**.
Replaced the spreadsheet month end with CSV imports of broker exports and an accounting ledger, **saving 6 hours a week**.
Added an AI assistant that answers from the fund's own data, using tool calling and streamed responses.

projects.name: wordy.cards
projects.description: German vocabulary PWA, Angular front end with a NestJS and MongoDB API behind it.
bullets: Implemented FSRS-5 spaced repetition over 3,500+ German words, grading each card by the time taken to flip it.
Made the PWA fully offline on IndexedDB, syncing progress in the background and fetching only changed lessons.
